remark: Portions of the Mission Bay boardwalk were closed due to water and ocean debris over the boardwalk starting at Belmont Park. Surf heights of 7-12 ft were observed at Mission Beach Thursday morning and high tide was 7.87 ft MLLW.
Street flooding reported on Mission Boulevard between Brighton Ct and Balboa Ct in South Mission Beach. High tide was 7.97 feet (MLLW) at La Jolla.
